justifications.safety: Atmospheric supernatural dread with no graphic gore, sexual content, or substances; the darker register was clearly established by the Writer's own paragraph 3, and this continuation actually pulls back from explicit body horror to implication.
justifications.continuity: Consistent with the burning match, boathouse, rocks, and dark lighthouse; the father's fireside tale plausibly extends the established oilskin-coat father detail without contradicting or over-specifying omitted history.
justifications.voice_match: Maintains third-person limited past tense on Mara, the same long-breathed clause rhythm, and the coastal-gothic imagery of sea and wrongness established in prior paragraphs.
justifications.single_turn: One self-contained paragraph that advances Mara's flight and deepens the mystery, with no meta-commentary, labels, or presumption of the Writer's next move.
